title: Bounded-below constant-module comparison data
statement: For the normalized derived constant-module comparisons [def-sfb-constant-module-derived-comparison-data] of a geometric constant-module datum [def-sfb-constant-module-geometric-comparison-data], define PlusIdentification to consist of inverse-image and right-derived direct-image comparison isomorphisms on $D^+$, where $D^+$ is the full subcategory of the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] whose cohomology vanishes below some integer. Require that both isomorphisms commute with the inclusions into the unbounded derived categories and with the canonical bounded-below/unbounded right-derived direct-image comparisons. Require the full bounded-below Hom adjunction equation and equality of each included bounded-below counit with the corresponding unbounded counit, using those canonical comparison isomorphisms. This defines a package of equations, without asserting existence or restricting the unbounded tensor inputs.
